Quick introduction: I’m Kimberly, Redwood’s GRC lead for new evaluations. I’ll be coordinating the evidence requests and cataloging submissions. Evelyn (cc) will be our technical evidence reviewer and will follow up on specifics around data handling.

Operational notes:
- Preferred evidence upload: secure SharePoint link (we’ll provide per-submission GUIDs); if you require SFTP, we can support that as well — let us know which you prefer
- Evidence format: PDFs, screenshots of console settings, and exported config files (.json/.yaml) are fine; please avoid sending full PII datasets
- Key documents we’ll request first: SOC 2 report (if available), user access reviews, backup policies, data retention policy, and network segmentation diagrams

I’ve attached a SOC2 questionnaire (SOC2_Questionnaire_v2.pdf) that maps to the initial evidentiary asks — you can start filling the questionnaire or point us at an existing folder where artifacts live.

Regarding procurement terms: Marcus Lin (AE, cc’d) will help triage any commercial tradeoffs; if needed, Jonas can open a legal thread for redline discussion. For scheduling, I propose a 30-min kickoff on Thursday, Oct 22 at 10:00 AM PT.
